chapter_seo_title: Precious Light Pavilion: Void Heaven Palace Inner Trial Begins
chapter_meta_description: Han Li accepts Bodhi Beads, a Nascent Soul-grade Talisman Treasure, and a borrowed scale armor from the demonic patriarchs before entering the Void Heaven Palace's inner trial. The Star Palace elders watch from the shadows.
og_title: The Demonic Patriarchs Open Their Vaults – Precious Light Pavilion Awaits
og_description: Extreme Yin, Man Brutal Beard, and the Confucian-robed elder each gift Han Li a rare treasure before he steps into the floating jade pavilion. But every gift is a leash.
twitter_title: Han Li Gets the Best Gear of His Life – All of It Borrowed
twitter_description: The demonic old freaks load Han Li with Bodhi Beads, a Nascent Soul Talisman Treasure, and scale armor. Every leash is a loan.

lore_anchors.definition: Spirit-calming beads that resist inner demons and illusions; extremely rare, and stringing four together is an act of lavish desperation.
A single-use talisman treasure created by a Nascent Soul cultivator; far more powerful than ordinary Talisman Treasures.
A scale-covered inner armor once used by a late-stage Nascent Soul cultivator; lent to Han Li with an implicit threat of reclaimation.
The supreme treasure sealed in the Void Heaven Palace's inner hall; the primary objective of the expedition.
A legendary pill that can repair damaged Five Elements roots; once nearly retrieved from the cauldron before the thief was ambushed.
A swarm-class spirit insect that can devour magical power; Han Li's primary trump card in the inner trial.
A floating jade pavilion in the inner void of the Void Heaven Palace; the immediate destination before the final trial.
